This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Nol Ilen]] and [[Jyss Cordam]] were members of this species.<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Near-Human]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by their wavy [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War]], one member of this species, [[Nol Ilen]], worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] on [[Lish V]], while another, [[Jyss Cordam]], was employed as a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] at [[Ti'mere's InfoServices]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in ''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]'', a [[1995]] supplement for the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]], written by [[Sterling Hershey]], illustrated by [[Scott Johnson]], [[Robert Kulp]], and [[Mike Vilardi]], and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />
